item.title: fix(cli): exit non-zero when an agent turn fails (#125557)
item.summary: fix(cli): exit non-zero when an agent turn fails (#125557) The gateway-routed path already mapped terminal run status to an exit code, but the local embedded path did not, so a failed turn exited 0 while its own JSON envelope reported status "error". Route both through the canonical agent-run terminal outcome, and fail closed on an unrecognized status since the gateway response carries an open string.
